# PlayerItemAttackEntityBeforeEvent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information about an attack initiated through a player item interaction before it causes effects. Set cancel to true to prevent the attack.

## Properties

### **aimDirection**
`read-only aimDirection?: Vector3;`

The normalized world-space direction used for the attack. For standard client-initiated transaction attacks, this direction is derived from the client-provided hit position and the player's server-side eye position. Other attack paths can provide a server-derived direction. This property is undefined when the attack path does not provide an aim direction.

Type: [*Vector3*](Vector3.md)

### **cancel**
`cancel: boolean;`

If set to true, the attack does not cause damage or other authoritative attack effects.

Type: *boolean*

### **itemStack**
`read-only itemStack?: ItemStack;`

A snapshot of the item held by the attacking player. This property is undefined when the player holds no item.

Type: [*ItemStack*](ItemStack.md)

### **player**
`read-only player: Player;`

The player that initiated the attack.

Type: [*Player*](Player.md)

### **target**
`read-only target: Entity;`

The entity targeted by the attack.

Type: [*Entity*](Entity.md)
